fato_historico: 1932: Mahatma Gandhi and B. R. Ambedkar agree to the Poona Pact, which reserved seats in the Indian provincial legislatures for the "Depressed Classes" (Untouchables).
energia_do_dia: Today, your innovative spirit may harmonize with the collective, much like a historic agreement that paved the way for inclusion and equality. It is a good time to consider how your unique vision can bridge divides. Perhaps you will find that by championing the voices around you, your own path becomes brighter and filled with clover-like luck.
frase_do_dia: True progress blooms when we walk forward hand in hand with our community.
significado_numero: Represents the balance and harmony found in collective social structures.
conselho: Seek opportunities to support those whose voices often remain unheard in your community.
